name: EmrtdKit
summary: Reads the chip in ICAO 9303 travel documents over NFC
description:
Reads eMRTD chips — ePassports and electronic identity cards — over
CoreNFC, covering BAC, PACE, Chip Authentication, Active
Authentication and Passive Authentication.

Derived from AndyQ/NFCPassportReader 2.3.3 (MIT), with JPEG2000
portrait decoding added for the documents ImageIO cannot decode.
